REA John Lee are delighted to present this exceptional residential site extending to approximately 0.140 hectares (0.35 acres), enjoying a highly sought-after setting at Keeper View, Clonbealy, Newport, Co. Tipperary. This outstanding property comes to the market with the significant advantage of Full Planning Permission for the construction of a substantial c. 512 sq.m. (c. 5,511 sq.ft.) luxury residence, together with a detached garage, offering purchasers the opportunity to create a truly impressive family home without the uncertainty and delays associated with obtaining planning approval. The approved design comprises an elegant two-storey residence with striking architectural features, generous reception rooms, extensive bedroom accommodation and a detached garage, all positioned to maximise the site??s attractive setting and privacy. Planning Ref: 2260709.
Situated on the edge of Newport Town, the property enjoys the perfect balance of peaceful residential living while remaining within walking distance of an excellent range of local amenities including schools, shops, cafs, sporting facilities and public transport. The University of Limerick, National Technological Park, Castletroy and the M7 motorway network are all within easy commuting distance, making this an ideal location for families and professionals alike. Opportunities to acquire fully serviced sites with planning permission for homes of this calibre are exceptionally rare in the Newport area.
Whether you are planning your forever home or seeking a premium residential development opportunity, this exceptional site offers the ideal foundation in one of Newport??s most desirable residential locations. Viewing is highly recommended and strictly by appointment through the sole selling agents, REA John Lee.

Full Planning Permission for an impressive c. 512 sq.m. residence
Detached garage included in the approved plans
Site extending to approximately 0.140 ha (0.35 acres)
Prestigious residential location within Keeper View
Walking distance to Newport Town and all amenities
Excellent commuter access to Limerick City, the University of Limerick and the M7 motorway
Attractive site with mature surroundings
A rare opportunity to build a landmark family residence
 
 All mains services adjacent.
